entities.summary: Gabriel Ramon Estaba García is a Venezuelan basketball player. Estaba played Venezuela's Liga Profesional de Baloncesto with Panteras de Lara, Panteras de Miranda and Marinos de Oriente. He played with the Venezuela national basketball team at the 1990 FIBA World Championship and 1992 Summer Olympics.
